83-type signature corresponding to InsDel_D (ID_D)

Note

WARNING: The 83-type ID_D extraction excluded the large proportion of T insertions in long poly-T contexts that were detected in extractions in the 89-type and 476-type classifications. This accounts for the low cosine similarity between the 83-type signature ID_D and the 476-type signature collapsed to the 83-type classification.

In the plot of the 83-type signature converted from the extracted 476-type signature, these account for 75% of mutations, and the other mutation classes are barely visible.

83-type signature converted from signature discovered in the 476-type spectra (using bipartite matching optimization) | cosine similarity to ID_D: 0.1632

Indels of T in long-poly-T regions were removed to allow visualization of other mutations. The locations of the removed values are indicated by 2 small negative bars.

Click to see flow diagrams: 476-type to 83-type collapse

These Sankey diagrams show how the 476-type mutation categories are redistributed to 83-type categories using bipartite matching. We only show the diagrams for insertions or deletions of > 1 base because it is for these indels that 476-type categories map to > 1 83-type category.
